title: Select right-sized Web 3D engines and enforce disposal, tree-shaking, and mobile ergonomics

contextSnapshot.surface: e-commerce 3D/AR product viewer and Vue/Svelte interactive 3D configurator
contextSnapshot.platform: Web (HTML, Vue 3 / TresJS v5, Babylon.js WebGPU)

prompt: Choose the right Web 3D engines for an AR product preview and an interactive WebGPU/WebXR configurator, avoiding bundle bloat, scroll traps, and GPU leaks.
forbiddenBehaviors: builds a full custom WebGL engine just to display a single GLB product preview when <model-viewer> fits
uses removed TresJS v4 useRenderLoop or useCamera APIs in TresJS v5
omits poster, alt, or touch-action='pan-y' on <model-viewer> or skips engine.dispose() in Babylon.js

rubricDimensions.pass: selects <model-viewer> for GLB/AR product previews and Babylon.js/PlayCanvas/Threlte/TresJS/luma.gl based on framework and scene complexity
rubricDimensions.fail: over-engineers a single product viewer or picks an engine mismatched to the host framework

rubricDimensions.pass: uses Babylon @babylonjs/core/* subpaths + WebGPUEngine initAsync({ xrCompatible: true }), TresJS v5 useLoop/useTres, and Threlte manual texture disposal notes
rubricDimensions.fail: uses deprecated v4 TresJS composables or monolithic unshaken imports

rubricDimensions.pass: includes poster, alt, touch-action='pan-y' on <model-viewer> and disposes engines/scenes on unmount
rubricDimensions.fail: hijacks mobile vertical scrolling or leaks WebGL/WebGPU contexts

negativeControls.name: tresjs v4 removed hook
negativeControls.input: call useRenderLoop() in a TresJS v5 Vue component
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend removed useRenderLoop() for TresJS v5

negativeControls.name: model-viewer missing poster and alt
negativeControls.input: render <model-viewer src='chair.glb' camera-controls /> without alt, poster, or touch-action
negativeControls.mustNot: omit alt, poster, and touch-action='pan-y' on <model-viewer>

baseline.withoutSkill: writes heavy custom Three.js code for simple GLB previews, copies deprecated TresJS v4 hooks, and leaks GPU resources on unmount
baseline.withSkill: right-sizes to <model-viewer> or tree-shaken Babylon.js/Threlte/TresJS v5 with accessible posters, non-blocking touch-action, and clean GPU disposal
